messages:
Noah: Dropped a compact-axis mock where units anchor to axis origin instead of auto-suffixing. Trying to reduce confusion on rate charts (per-s vs total).
Priya: screenshot? :eyes:
Noah: attached in staging. quick note: anchored units stop switching between K/M which ops complained about.
Eli: UX question: how do we expose anchor control? Per-chart toggle in legend header or detect by metric type?
Marin: prefer explicit control. Add small toggle: 'Units: auto | anchored | raw' in legend dropdown. Anchor means keep base unit (e.g., per-s) and only change scale factor.
Priya: accessibility: when units change announce via live region: 'Units set to anchored (per second)'. Don't announce on every hover update.
Noah: also added an axis-smoothing option to reduce tick jitter on high-frequency charts. It snaps ticks to nice intervals when zooming.
Eli: perf: snapping should be cheap, only compute on axis-change. Avoid reflow on every mousemove.
Marin: outlier handling: two modes proposed — clip (render chevron + tooltip) or adaptive zoom (temporarily rescale to include spike). Product prefers clip by default.
Priya: make clipped marker keyboard-focusable and give aria-label 'clipped: raw 12345'. Also include a small 'view raw' action in the tooltip that can be keyboard activated.
Noah: sample CSS for clipped marker I used: 
```
.marker--clipped { fill: transparent; stroke: var(--red-600); stroke-width: 1.5px; shape-rendering: crispEdges; }
```
Eli: nice. microcopy for tooltip: "Value clipped at 99.5th percentile for readability. Press Enter to expand."
Marin: smoothing: default smoothing off for short series. rule: if points < 12, smoothing disabled. Add badge in legend when smoothing is active 'smoothed'.
Priya: keyboard: Tab lands on legend items; Enter toggles series, Shift+Enter isolates. Add 'S' shortcut to toggle smoothing for focused series. Announce via live region 'Smoothing enabled for series X'.
Noah: export behavior: CSV should include raw_value and displayed_value plus clip_reason column. Keep timestamps ISO-8601.
Eli: API detail: frontend will pass clip_pct in the query (e.g., clip_pct=99.5) and backend returns clipped_count and a small sample of clipped_points for quick tooltips.
Marin: one more tiny UX: when users disable clipping the chart should animate scale change smoothly to avoid jarring jumps. Use 300ms transition.
ChartBot: Preview: https://staging.redwood.com/visuals/axis-anchor-2460 snapshot ux-2460
Priya: assigning tasks: Eli draft API + aria text, Marin handle animation & legend placement, Noah tweak microcopy and CSS tokens. Review next Tue.
